boundary: All failures are retained with zero evidence credit; the canonical pass was not rerun.

negatives.failure: The first no-test closeout preflight confirmed two privacy-pattern hits in literal negative examples embedded in the closeout test.
negatives.recovery: Construct the same negative examples from split string fragments so the test checks the policy without publishing scanner-shaped payload.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Privacy-negative unit tests must not embed the prohibited payload spelling they are intended to reject.

negatives.failure: The first no-test closeout preflight counted five unittest FailedTest placeholders because repository-root imports were unresolved and loader errors were not fail-closed.
negatives.recovery: Insert the exact repository root before module loading and reject any nonempty unittest loader error list.
negatives.recurrence_guard: A loaded test count is valid only when the explicit module loader error list is empty.

negatives.failure: A post-pass manifest patch guessed stale surrounding bytes and hash context and was rejected before changing the manifest.
negatives.recovery: Read the exact manifest structure and regenerate every static entry from measured Git-blob hashes in one bounded owner-scoped refresh.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Never patch a generated manifest against inferred byte counts or hash context.

negatives.failure: A multi-file post-pass receipt update used malformed patch-hunk grammar and was rejected without mutation.
negatives.recovery: Apply one small exact-context receipt patch at a time before refreshing measured Git blobs.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not combine unrelated receipt updates in a patch whose hunk has no exact context.
